title: Pollen (CEO Negus-Fancey, CTO Wright) tried to remove article, and Google helped
summary: A Pragmatic Engineer blog post detailing how travel tech company Pollen attempted to force removal of an article critical of their CEO Callum Negus-Fancey, with Google allegedly assisting in the takedown process through DMCA requests.
problem_solved: Exposes potential abuse of copyright takedown mechanisms by corporations to silence journalistic criticism
why_valuable: Highlights transparency issues and power dynamics between tech platforms and corporations in content moderation decisions
